funding_notes: affirm.com; HQ San Francisco; founded 2012 by Max Levchin (HVF). Public on Nasdaq (AFRM) since its Jan 2021 IPO (28.29M shares at $49, ~$1.31B gross incl. over-allotment per SEC 8-K). Sourced private rounds: 2015 $275M equity+debt (split not disclosed, Spark Capital Growth lead), Series D $100M (2016, Founders Fund), Series F $300M (2019, Thrive), Series G $500M (2020, GIC & Durable). amount_raised sums only the sourced, equity-only D/F/G rounds; seed-Series C, the 2015 equity portion and the ~2017 Series E are not itemized, so the list is not exhaustive. IPO proceeds excluded from the total.
